definitions.explanation: Describes a healthy, attractive shine or luster, especially on hair, skin, or food surfaces. Implies good condition and vitality.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{髪|かみ}はつやつやしている。
examples.english: Her hair is glossy and shiny.

examples.japanese: つやつやの{肌|はだ}を{保|たも}つために{保湿|ほしつ}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Moisturizing is important to maintain glossy skin.

examples.japanese: {炊|た}きたてのご{飯|はん}はつやつやして{美味|おい}しそうだ。
examples.english: Freshly cooked rice looks delicious with its glossy shine.

notes:
つやつや describes a healthy, attractive luster that implies good condition, freshness, or vitality. It is always positive — unlike some shine words that can suggest greasiness.

FORMS:
- つやつやの〜: modifier (つやつやの{髪|かみ})
- つやつやした〜: modifier (つやつやした{肌|はだ})
- つやつやしている: is glossy/lustrous
- つやつやな〜: na-adjective modifier

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- つやつやの{髪|かみ}: glossy hair
- つやつやの{肌|はだ}: lustrous skin
- つやつやしたご{飯|はん}: shiny rice (sign of freshly cooked, good quality)
- つやつやの{林檎|りんご}: shiny apple

CONTRAST WITH OTHER SHINE WORDS:
- ぴかぴか: sparkling clean (polished surfaces, new items)
- きらきら: glittering, twinkling (like stars or jewelry)
- てかてか: oily/greasy shine (often negative)
- すべすべ: smooth to the touch (texture, not visual shine)
